rows.name: Fire
rows.note: Ignite: fixed 5 s duration in the effect; its own burn tick reads Data.Damage, which mods can't set, so the burn damage is dealt by the mod. Verified: flames show on the enemy.

rows.name: Lightning
rows.note: Shock: duration and CritChanceResistanceModifier are SetByCaller; swapped to fixed values on the effect's default object for the call. Damage scales with ElectroDamageModifier.

rows.name: Cryo
rows.note: Chill: MovementSpeed and MaxGroundSpeedMultiplier x magnitude (SetByCaller, swapped to 0.5 = half speed).

rows.name: Cryo
rows.note: Freeze: movement overridden to 0 and animations paused; only the duration is SetByCaller.

rows.name: Void
rows.note: Corruption: the enemy's GlobalDamageMultiplier -0.2 (it deals 20% less).

rows.name: Radiation
rows.note: Irradiate: WeakpointDamageMitigationMultiplier -0.25 (weak points take more damage).

rows.name: Psionic
rows.note: Fracture: IncomingStaggerChance +0.3 (both SetByCaller modifiers get the same value).

rows.name: Nano
rows.note: Infect: the Nano status visual; its modifier is NanoInfectReplenishmentChance.

rows.name: Anti-Gravity
rows.note: Anti-gravity stun: lifts the enemy; only the duration is SetByCaller.
